page.layout: One page of text: a centred title block at the top, then a verse poem in italic set in lines, with a drop cap L. The catchword "Sunt" stands at the right below the last line. Running head at the top. No margin notes.

main_text.head: ROD. GOCLENII MEDIC. DOCTOR. RAPHAELIS EGLINI ICONII TIGURINI, SS. Theologiæ Doctoris, & Professoris Ordinarii in inclyta Academia Marpurgensi, Carmen.

p.i: Laurea debetur duplici tibi nomine Phœbe, Quòd tua testudo est, quòd Medicina tua est.
Herbarum inde tibi diuina potentia seruit; Inde genus Vatum surgit & ordo tibi.
Scilicet hinc ex te, Nymphaq; Coronide, nato Delubrum veluti constituere Deo.
Fallor an ambigua est Graiorum fabula? Nostris Debetur potius temporibusq; fides ?
Ecce parens Vatum GOCLENIVS ille, RODOLPHVS, Ecce RODOLPHVS item filius ille Patris,

page.notes: The drop cap L is joined to "aurea" as "Laurea". The page number "1" is a small mark after the running head and is doubtful. The printed "fides ?" has a space before the question mark, copied as printed. "Nymphaq;" is copied as printed, with q; for -que.
